notes: Fast Track entry-choice bugfix: a peg that LANDS on its own ft-{bp} hole now correctly gets both options (continue on the outer rim OR jump to the inner fast-track ring). Previous build required the peg to be sitting at its own home hole to enter FT — geometrically unreachable from clockwise movement (75 steps away) — so the FT-entry choice was effectively never offered. Combined with v0.5.12's auto-commit-on-single-choice, this silently kept pegs on the main track every time they hit FT.
